segments.name: Market Making
segments.description: Makes markets in cash, futures and options across equities, fixed income, currencies, cryptocurrencies and commodities, providing liquidity to broker dealers, banks and institutional clients.
segments.evidence: Our Market Making segment principally consists of market making in the cash, futures, and options markets across global equities, fixed income, currencies, cryptocurrencies, and commodities.

segments.name: Execution Services
segments.description: Provides trading, clearing and related services, plus trading analytics, to customers and clients.
segments.evidence: Our execution services and client solutions products are designed to be transparent, because we believe transparency makes markets more efficient and helps investors make better, more informed decisions.

revenueModel.text: Broker dealers, banks and institutional clients pay through the bid/ask spread as Virtu buys and sells large volumes of securities on a principal basis.
revenueModel.evidence: we generate revenue by buying and selling large volumes of securities and other financial instruments while earning small bid/ask spreads.

changes.text: Virtu sold its interest in the RFQ-hub request-for-quote joint venture to MarketAxess in 2025 and deconsolidated the platform.
changes.evidence: The sale was completed on May 9, 2025.
